title: Tireso - Weapon Stats & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Tireso in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - which character uses it, its element and scaling, and exactly where to get it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Tireso is a earth-element weapon used by Gustave / Verso. It scales with Vitality (A), Defense (B).

sections.title: Is the Tireso Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Vitality (A), Defense (B). A dedicated earth pick - it belongs in a build already committed to that element.
